hook: Count the bounces. Can you keep up with the sensor?
outcome: Compare human counts with sensor data and use a picture graph to identify the bounciest ball
sources: CSTA K-12 Computer Science Standards, 2017: 1A-DA-06 and 1A-DA-07; 2026 module identifiers.
FIBA Basketball Equipment 2024: current rebound reference; the required basketball factor 0.85 is retained as a model choice, not a certification claim.
ITF Rules of Tennis, Appendix I: ball rebound test.
OpenStax College Physics 2e, sections 2.7 and 8.5: ideal free fall and energy loss in collisions.
Bounce factors, visible-bounce cut-off and tap matching window are a model chosen for this tool.
